article.title: Duolingo與Pokémon GO以學習任務交換遊戲獎勵
article.summary: Duolingo與Pokémon GO展開跨平台合作，將語言課程與遊戲活動連結。
highlights: Duolingo的限時任務讓完成每日課程的參與者解鎖Pokémon主題造型。
在七個不同日子完成課程，可取得代碼並參與Pokémon GO的限時調查。
article.why: 跨品牌合作可把回訪行為與對方平台的獎勵連結，設計可追蹤的參與及兌換步驟。
article.next_step: 為同類合作分別定義課程完成、代碼領取及兌換成功，並檢查資格和到期提示。
article.detail: 據Marketing-Interactive報道，合作於11月17日開始。Pokémon GO玩家可選擇一種語言，讓限時調查任務以該語言呈現，再透過遊戲活動練習。合作亦加入展示不同語言寶可夢名稱的Language Tag。團隊可以觀察從日常任務到另一平台體驗的設計，逐步核對每一個獎勵取得條件。
article.title_en: Duolingo and Pokémon GO connect learning tasks with game rewards
article.summary_en: Duolingo and Pokémon GO launched a cross-platform collaboration connecting language lessons with game activities.
highlights_en: A limited-time Duolingo quest unlocks Pokémon-themed outfits for participants completing daily lessons.
Lessons on seven different days can unlock an offer code for Pokémon GO Timed Research.
article.why_en: Brand partnerships can tie repeat visits to rewards on a partner platform through measurable participation and redemption steps.
article.next_step_en: Define lesson completion, code collection and redemption separately and check eligibility and expiry prompts.
article.detail_en: Marketing-Interactive reports that the collaboration began on November 17. Pokémon GO players can choose a language for Timed Research tasks and practise it through gameplay. A Language Tag also shows Pokémon names in different languages. Teams can examine the path from a daily task to a partner experience and verify each reward condition.
